Required: BE(⁴He) = 28.29566 MeV. **No row has a root.** In every row where the deuteron is in the contact regime, the cooperative support (skin inside two wells at once) is zero or tiny: patches subtend 19–27° of the capsid and two patches 60° apart do not meet until each exceeds 30°. Where support exists (δ = 0.25 fm, r = 1) E1 = e₀ adds 0.06 MeV to ⁴He against the 23 MeV missing; E1 = 3 e₀ adds 0.23. Reaching ⁴He would need E1 ≈ 400 e₀. The one row that reports a root (r3_d2_kb0.3, E1 = 1.84 e₀) is **spurious**: the ⁴He state at that E1 is a collapsed ball (closest centroids 0.49 fm, skin to 2.08 fm) — the cooperative term is a positive feedback (overlap → coop → more overlap) and the structure jumps first-order from BE 4.0 to 58.7 MeV between E1 = 0.52 and 1.55 MeV/fm². **Rim recovery as skin-sharing has no geometric support at membrane contact sizes, and where it has support it is unstable.** [COMPUTED]
